title: A simple home with chosen convenience

captions.energy: Keeping familiar comfort despite its cost

meaning: Your domestic support becomes calmer when completed arrangements allow familiar convenience to be chosen instead of requiring every pleasant possibility to remain for feeling at home.
text: You may want an inhabited home where tasks connect and essentials are available without unnecessary fuss. The World in the physical position of Muladhara appears through completing these shared arrangements. The Devil in energy can retain familiar comfort despite its cost. The Hermit in emotions wants peace through meaningful simplicity. A ready home can gradually grow heavier: both have settled, but every convenience stays compulsory even when requiring excessive space and care. Simplicity is needed yet feels like losing something that once offered security.

For example, a resting place is convenient, but many rarely used throws, magazines and accessories stay nearby. Tidying is continual; relinquishing choice feels regrettable. **Simplicity can preserve pleasure by giving familiar convenience a manageable place.** Discussing present use reveals what is valuable and burdensome separately. Not every favourite must disappear, but ready arrangements need not continuously maintain every possibility unused for a long time within ordinary domestic life.

The difficulty is treating reduction as rejection of comfort and seeking storage that preserves workload. Support grows when both can love convenience and choose enough. A completed home sustains available life: calm follows benefit and cost being recognised together without compulsory attachment to every object rather than preserving every pleasure forever. The useful whole can contain fewer obligations and remain your home.
